## Required for KSA 2026.11.10.5801
KSA 2026.11.10.5801 replaced the atmosphere model with a layered profile and removed the hook that StarMap uses for its immediate load. This update is mandatory on KSA 2026.11.10.5801 and above; the previous version fails there as soon as guidance or the engine data reads the atmosphere.

## Changes
- Guidance now flies the game's layered atmosphere. It samples the game's own density and pressure from sea level to the top of the atmosphere, so ascent, boostback, entry and landing plans follow the new air. Earth's atmosphere now reaches about 173 km, so plans differ from the previous build.
- The boostback gauge shows the scale height at sea level and the speed of sound of the body's air.
- A body whose air ends at the surface (Ganymede) counts as airless, as it does in the game's physics.
- The AUTOSTAGE gauge button is registered before the game reads its gauges, without the removed StarMap immediate-load hook.
- AutoStage reads the subparts of a part in the new part data layout.
